description: Ordinary-player capture, ownership transfer, conservation, denial and transactional rollback for empty planets.

tests.name: Setup: acquiring ordinary player
Setup: former planet owner
Setup: unrelated player
Select a non-FedSpace sector

data.sql: SELECT MIN(sector_id) FROM sectors WHERE sector_id > 10;

tests.name: Fund player bank account for corporation charter

data.sql: UPDATE bank_accounts SET balance=100000 WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=@{v3_unpop_acquirer_player_id} AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE;

tests.name: Place players and ships at the test sector with combat capacity

data.sql: UPDATE players SET sector_id=@{planet_acq_sector},lastplanet=0 WHERE player_id IN (@{v3_unpop_acquirer_player_id},@{v3_unpop_former_owner_player_id},@{v3_unpop_outsider_player_id});

tests.name: Set active ships at the test sector with combat capacity

data.sql: UPDATE ships SET sector_id=@{planet_acq_sector},onplanet=FALSE,fighters=100 WHERE ship_id IN (SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id IN (@{v3_unpop_acquirer_player_id},@{v3_unpop_former_owner_player_id},@{v3_unpop_outsider_player_id}));

tests.name: Create deterministic unpopulated planets with conserved assets

data.sql: INSERT INTO planets (planet_id,sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,population,population_type,colonists_unassigned,colonists_ore,colonists_org,colonists_eq,colonists_weapons,fighters,ore_on_hand,organics_on_hand,equipment_on_hand,created_by,type) SELECT x.planet_id,@{planet_acq_sector},x.name,@{v3_unpop_former_owner_player_id},'player','M',0,'UNPOPULATED',0,0,0,0,0,10,123,234,345,@{admin_player_id},(SELECT MIN(planettypes_id) FROM planettypes) FROM (VALUES (977740,'Unpopulated Acquisition QA'),(977741,'Unpopulated Rollback QA'),(977742,'Unpopulated Conflicting Claim QA')) AS x(planet_id,name) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET sector_id=EXCLUDED.sector_id,name=EXCLUDED.name,owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id,owner_type='player',population=0,population_type='UNPOPULATED',colonists_unassigned=0,colonists_ore=0,colonists_org=0,colonists_eq=0,colonists_weapons=0,fighters=10,ore_on_hand=123,organics_on_hand=234,equipment_on_hand=345;

tests.name: Seed citadel treasuries on both deterministic worlds

data.sql: INSERT INTO citadels(planet_id,level,treasury,owner_id) VALUES (977740,1,456,@{v3_unpop_former_owner_player_id}),(977741,1,789,@{v3_unpop_former_owner_player_id}) ON CONFLICT (planet_id) DO UPDATE SET level=1,treasury=EXCLUDED.treasury,owner_id=EXCLUDED.owner_id;

tests.name: Refresh acquirer session location
Reject missing planet identity
Install a database constraint to inject failure after combat begins

data.sql: ALTER TABLE planets ADD CONSTRAINT v3_unpop_capture_rollback CHECK (planet_id <> 977741 OR owner_id=@{v3_unpop_former_owner_player_id});

tests.name: Failed capture returns an error
Capture failure rolls back fighters, population, ownership, stock, treasury and event

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.owner_id=@{v3_unpop_former_owner_player_id} AND p.owner_type='player' AND p.population=0 AND p.population_type='UNPOPULATED' AND p.colonists_unassigned+p.colonists_ore+p.colonists_org+p.colonists_eq+p.colonists_weapons=0 AND p.fighters=10 AND p.ore_on_hand=123 AND p.organics_on_hand=234 AND p.equipment_on_hand=345 AND c.treasury=789 AND s.fighters=100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE type='player.capture_planet.v1' AND payload LIKE '%977741%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN citadels c USING(planet_id) JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{v3_unpop_acquirer_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id WHERE p.planet_id=977741;

tests.name: Remove fault injection after rollback assertion

data.sql: ALTER TABLE planets DROP CONSTRAINT v3_unpop_capture_rollback;

tests.name: Ordinary player captures an unpopulated planet
Capture preserves unpopulated state, zero allocations, stock and citadel treasury

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.owner_id=@{v3_unpop_acquirer_player_id} AND p.owner_type='player' AND p.population=0 AND p.population_type='UNPOPULATED' AND p.colonists_unassigned+p.colonists_ore+p.colonists_org+p.colonists_eq+p.colonists_weapons=0 AND p.fighters=0 AND p.ore_on_hand=123 AND p.organics_on_hand=234 AND p.equipment_on_hand=345 AND c.treasury=456 AND s.fighters=90 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM engine_events WHERE type='player.capture_planet.v1' AND payload LIKE '%977740%')=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN citadels c USING(planet_id) JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{v3_unpop_acquirer_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id WHERE p.planet_id=977740;

tests.name: Planet information response agrees with captured owner and unpopulated state
Former owner cannot transfer a captured planet
Denied former-owner transfer leaves the captured state unchanged

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN owner_id=@{v3_unpop_acquirer_player_id} AND owner_type='player' AND population=0 AND population_type='UNPOPULATED' AND fighters=0 AND ore_on_hand=123 AND organics_on_hand=234 AND equipment_on_hand=345 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets WHERE planet_id=977740;

tests.name: Inject a competing ownership change at the capture compare-and-set boundary

data.sql: CREATE FUNCTION v3_qa_competing_planet_claim() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF OLD.ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM players WHERE player_id=@{v3_unpop_acquirer_player_id}) AND NEW.fighters<OLD.fighters THEN UPDATE planets SET owner_id=@{v3_unpop_outsider_player_id} WHERE planet_id=977742; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $$;

tests.name: Install competing-claim trigger

data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER v3_qa_competing_planet_claim BEFORE UPDATE OF fighters ON ships FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION v3_qa_competing_planet_claim();

tests.name: Reject a stale capture after a competing owner change
Competing ownership change and combat costs roll back atomically

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.owner_id=@{v3_unpop_former_owner_player_id} AND p.owner_type='player' AND p.population=0 AND p.population_type='UNPOPULATED' AND p.fighters=10 AND s.fighters=90 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM engine_events WHERE type='player.capture_planet.v1' AND payload LIKE '%977742%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM planets p JOIN players pl ON pl.player_id=@{v3_unpop_acquirer_player_id} JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=pl.ship_id WHERE p.planet_id=977742;
